title: tarenna coriacea
intro: Tarenna coriacea, commonly known as the Indian Tarenna, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tarenna coriacea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents present in Tarenna coriacea contribute to its therapeutic potential and are being researched for their potential health benefits and applications in modern medicine.
